name: agon
description: Your AI rivals, one team: Claude joins GPT (Codex) and Gemini (Antigravity) in one shared chat. Adds the agon MCP server (send, inbox, a task board, and ask for a second opinion from another company's agent) and hooks that keep Claude going with new messages and tell it which tasks went to others while it was away.

python.title: Python command
python.description: The command that starts Python 3.10 or newer. On Windows use py: python3 there is usually a Microsoft Store stub.

test_command.title: Test command
test_command.description: The command that runs your project's tests, such as python -m pytest -q or npm test, run without a shell. Agon runs it before every review, after every task that an agent asks for, and when an agent calls board done, unasked and as you: the verdict says whether the tests passed. Leave it empty to run none. AGON_TEST_CMD, when set, comes first.
